# Fork-owned targets that must exist after the OrcaSlicer target is defined.
# src/CMakeLists.txt reaches this file with a single add_subdirectory; add new
# fork targets here, not there.
add_subdirectory(Mcp/Bridge)
# Bridge exports the AppImage packaging hook one scope up. This file is now
# that scope; forward it to src/ where build_linux_image.sh.in is configured.
set(SLIC3R_PACKAGE_EXTRA_SCRIPT "${SLIC3R_PACKAGE_EXTRA_SCRIPT}" PARENT_SCOPE)
add_subdirectory(Web)

option(JUSPRIN_BUILD_WEB "Build the Agent and Home web bundles with npm" ON)
if (NOT JUSPRIN_BUILD_WEB)
    return()   # a prebuilt resources/jusprin/<page>/index.html must then be supplied by hand
endif()

if (WIN32)
    find_program(JUSPRIN_NPM NAMES npm.cmd npm)
else()
    find_program(JUSPRIN_NPM NAMES npm)
endif()
if (NOT JUSPRIN_NPM)
    message(FATAL_ERROR "npm not found. Node.js is required to build the JusPrin Agent and Home pages "
                        "(or configure with -DJUSPRIN_BUILD_WEB=OFF and supply the bundles yourself).")
endif()

set(_jusprin_web_shared_inputs
    ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/resources/jusprin/ui/design-tokens.json)
file(GLOB_RECURSE _jusprin_web_shared_glob CONFIGURE_DEPENDS
    ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../WebShared/*
    ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/resources/jusprin/ui/icons/*)
list(APPEND _jusprin_web_shared_inputs ${_jusprin_web_shared_glob})

function(jusprin_web_bundle name project_dir output)
    file(GLOB_RECURSE _src CONFIGURE_DEPENDS ${project_dir}/src/*)
    set(_stamp ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/${name}-node_modules.stamp)
    add_custom_command(OUTPUT ${_stamp}
        COMMAND ${JUSPRIN_NPM} ci --no-audit --no-fund
        COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND} -E touch ${_stamp}
        DEPENDS ${project_dir}/package.json ${project_dir}/package-lock.json
        WORKING_DIRECTORY ${project_dir}
        COMMENT "npm ci (${name})"
        VERBATIM)
    add_custom_command(OUTPUT ${output}
        COMMAND ${JUSPRIN_NPM} run build
        DEPENDS ${_stamp} ${_src} ${_jusprin_web_shared_inputs}
                ${project_dir}/index.html ${project_dir}/vite.config.ts ${project_dir}/tsconfig.json
        WORKING_DIRECTORY ${project_dir}
        COMMENT "vite build (${name}) -> ${output}"
        VERBATIM)
endfunction()

jusprin_web_bundle(agent ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../AgentUI ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/resources/jusprin/agent/index.html)
jusprin_web_bundle(home  ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../HomeUI  ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/resources/jusprin/home/index.html)

add_custom_target(jusprin_web ALL DEPENDS
    ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/resources/jusprin/agent/index.html
    ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/resources/jusprin/home/index.html)
add_dependencies(OrcaSlicer jusprin_web)

## Building

CMake builds this page whenever an input changes (`npm ci` from the lockfile, then `npm run build`). The output is `resources/jusprin/agent/index.html`; it is generated, not committed. Node/npm is required unless you configure with `-DJUSPRIN_BUILD_WEB=OFF` and supply that file yourself.

```bash
cmake --build build/arm64 --config RelWithDebInfo --target jusprin_web
```

The bundle must stay a single self-contained file (`vite-plugin-singlefile`):
WKWebView does not reliably load `file:` subresources.

To point the running app at a Vite dev server instead of the packaged file (hot
module reload):

```bash
cd src/slic3r/GUI/JusPrin/AgentUI && npm run dev
JUSPRIN_AGENT_DEV_URL=http://localhost:5173 ./build/arm64/src/OrcaSlicer.app/Contents/MacOS/OrcaSlicer
```

Adjust the binary path for your build tree and platform. The environment
variable is read once at construction; there is no settings UI for it.

input.contents:
# JusPrin Home UI

The local React/TypeScript application that renders the Home gallery and
printer column inside `wxWebView`. It talks to OrcaSlicer exclusively through
the versioned `jusprin-home-bridge` JSON protocol whose shared source of truth
is `resources/jusprin/home/protocol.json`; the native side lives in
`src/slic3r/GUI/JusPrin/Home/`.

## Building

CMake builds this page whenever an input changes (`npm ci` from the lockfile, then `npm run build`). The output is `resources/jusprin/home/index.html`; it is generated, not committed. Node/npm is required unless you configure with `-DJUSPRIN_BUILD_WEB=OFF` and supply that file yourself.

```bash
cmake --build build/arm64 --config RelWithDebInfo --target jusprin_web
```

The bundle must stay a single self-contained file (`vite-plugin-singlefile`):
WKWebView does not reliably load `file:` subresources.

To point the running app at a Vite dev server instead of the packaged file (hot
module reload):

```bash
cd src/slic3r/GUI/JusPrin/HomeUI && npm run dev
JUSPRIN_HOME_DEV_URL=http://localhost:5174 ./build/arm64/src/OrcaSlicer.app/Contents/MacOS/OrcaSlicer
```

Adjust the binary path for your build tree and platform. The environment
variable is read once at construction; there is no settings UI for it.

## Testing

```bash
npm test        # vitest: protocol, store, and style-contract tests
```

        DEPENDS ${project_dir}/package.json ${project_dir}/package-lock.json
